subject: visual-visibility
text: - Nodes with `display: none` or `visibility: hidden` or carrying `inert`, and their descendants, are excluded from the accessibility tree, and so from the snapshot — a select's option excepted from `display: none` (§4 Hidden content), so a select's options are its children in the tree and the snapshot; a hit answers nothing at an element carrying `inert`, before any other test, so a hit passes through it, and removing `inert` restores the tree and the hit (the `inert` read ratified by the founder (2026-10-18)) (packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:19-28; packages/blitz-dom/src/accessibility.rs:277-297; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1437-1446; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:104-363); a hit also skips a node dropped since the last resolve (architecture §Standard Contracts → Scrolling, selection, tree)

subject: visual-visibility
text: - Elements with `visibility: hidden` or `collapse` are never hit-test targets (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1448-1456)

subject: visual-visibility
text: - `pointer-events: none` makes an element transparent to hits while its descendants are still tested (packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1458-1462; packages/blitz-dom/src/node/node.rs:1668-1676)

subject: visual-visibility
text: - Right after a `scroll`, a main-button pointerdown inside the shown overlay scrollbar's band is taken as a thumb drag and dispatches nothing (`hit_with_scrollbar` while `scrollbar_opacity > 0`, `packages/blitz-dom/src/events/pointer.rs`); on the virtual clock the bar stays shown until an `advance` passes its fade, and a pointer resting on the thumb keeps it shown, so a driver `click` on a cell in that band needs an `advance` past the fade first (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_cells_served.rs:216-232 — as measured at escher-0.2.0/chunks/2026-10-25-cold-agent-bar/report.md)
